title: Clean local check-in for cafeteria and flashlight validation work
objective: Inspect the current working tree, identify the intended changes from the recent cafeteria v2 / flashlight lighting / fixed-exposure work, and create a clean local commit or small coherent commits if needed. Do not push.
instructions: User explicitly approved check-in with: 'Lets do it cleanly'.
Inspect status and diffs before committing. Separate intentional source/docs/config changes from generated outputs, logs, caches, temporary files, and bulky artifacts.

Commit only intended repo changes related to the current batch: experimenter/Tower support if present, world ledger/state/docs, cafeteria v2 import/recipe docs, flashlight indirect-lighting controls, scene-light intensity scaling, fixed exposure defaults, README/examples, and tests.
Do not push, do not open a PR, and do not rewrite history.
If there are ambiguous or risky untracked/binary/large files, leave them uncommitted and report them clearly instead of guessing.
Use concise commit message(s) that accurately describe the committed scope.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket with commit hash(es), committed files summary, intentionally uncommitted files, and any risks.
definition_of_done: A clean local check-in exists for intended changes, or Git-master reports a blocker with exact ambiguous files.
